positive control: the all-lamps complement map pi(s) = 511 XOR s (every lamp flipped) commutes with every button press because toggling is XOR, so it is a genuine symmetry under the pinned-button reading and should be admitted

main positive control: the FULL 8-element board symmetry group D4 (identity, three rotations, four reflections), each element carrying its own button renaming -- the second non-trivial positive control of this court, after mini2048's D4 and on a different mechanism (toggle algebra instead of merge-and-slide)

the direct product D4 x C2 (order 16): the board group and the all-lamps complement generate it because the complement commutes with every D4 element (asserted by the generator); each element (d, c^k) carries the button renaming of its D4 partner d -- the complement itself renames nothing
